newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA V AUSTRALIA SECOND TEST TOSS/TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA V AUSTRALIA SECOND TEST TOSS/TEAMS.

text.p: Australian won the toss and put South Africa in to bat on the first day of the second test on Friday.
The Australians named the same side that won the first test in Johannesburg while South Africa included an extra batsman, Herschelle Gibbs, in place of all rounder Lance Klusener.
South Africa - Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Herschelle Gibbs, Brian McMillan, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Allan Donald, Paul Adams.
Australia - Matthew Hayden, Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath.
